@@ -352,6 +352,40 @@ async def test_do_not_block_on_background_tasks() -> None:
     ]
 
 
+@pytest.mark.anyio
+async def test_background_task_exception_is_propagated() -> None:
+    async def failing_task() -> None:
+        await anyio.sleep(0)
+        raise RuntimeError("Background task failed")
+
+    async def endpoint_with_background_task(_: Request) -> PlainTextResponse:
+        return PlainTextResponse(background=BackgroundTask(failing_task))
+
+    async def passthrough(request: Request, call_next: RequestResponseEndpoint) -> Response:
+        return await call_next(request)
+
+    app = Starlette(
+        middleware=[Middleware(BaseHTTPMiddleware, dispatch=passthrough)],
+        routes=[Route("/", endpoint_with_background_task)],
+    )
+
+    scope = {
+        "type": "http",
+        "version": "3",
+        "method": "GET",
+        "path": "/",
+    }
+
+    async def receive() -> Message:
+        raise NotImplementedError("Should not be called!")
+
+    async def send(message: Message) -> None:
+        pass
+
+    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="Background task failed"):
+        await app(scope, receive, send)
+
+
